int.text:
Optimus! Looks like I got here just 
in time!
I like to make a dramatic entrance.
Here, head into the service ducts. They should lead to the lower prison levels. That's probably where Zeta's being held.
Uhh...not to be rude, but...we ARE on a tight timeline, here.

Seriously, they're going to break
that door down any minute!

fra.text: Vite, ils vont défoncer cette porte d'une seconde à l'autre !

int.text: I was wondering when you guys were gonna show up.
Hey Sideswipe! Less talking, more shooting!

You know, it was a lot quicker when
I was rescuing YOU guys.
I spied the central control room on my way in. From there we can override every hard-lock in the prison.

Feel free to venture out on your 
own, Sideswipe. No one will miss 
you.

fra.text: Tu n'es pas obligé de nous suivre, Sideswipe. Tu ne manqueras à personne ici.

int.text: The control room is just up ahead!

fra.text: La salle de contrôle est droit devant !

int.text: There! That console controls every cell in the prison.
Well...no. According to this, Zeta's locked down in a maximum security bunker on one of the lower levels.
See you on the outside, Autobots!

fra.text: Vous avez intérêt à revenir entiers !

int.text: Don't get TOO cocky--I suspect we aren't alone.

fra.text: Restez vigilants... je sens qu'on n'est pas seul.

int.text: You'll have to nullify two containment protocols--each with its own switch.  But be careful.  There may be more of those cloakers in the tunnels.
My recon showed a hangar bay nearby. We can use their own dropships to help the prisoners escape!

fra.text: J'ai repéré un hangar pas loin d'ici. On va utiliser leurs propres transports pour évacuer les prisonniers !

int.text:
I hope you know what you're doing,
Optimus.

fra.text: J'espère que tu sais ce que tu fais, Optimus.

int.text: Recycling? That doesn't seem so bad.

Uhhh, Optimus? This is all part of
the plan, right?

I sure wish I had a blaster right
now!

fra.text: Qu'est-ce que je donnerais pour un bon blaster !

int.text: So glad of you to notice!
I've heard stories of this place...but to SEE it...! It's horrifying.
That noise!  Its scrambling my logic circuits!
Hey -- LOOK! Soundwave has to leave the shield to help his runts!
They took our guns. Again. Anybody got any ideas?

fra.text: Ils ont encore pris nos armes ! Quelqu'un a une idée ?

int.text: Look at all those prison cells!
These cells are hard-locked. Optimus! Can you chop through the wall again?
Look! There's Air Raid, in that cell up ahead!

fra.text: Regardez ! Dans cette cellule ! C'est Air Raid !

int.text: These guys aren't gonna make it easy for us, are they?

fra.text: Ces types ne vont pas nous faciliter la tâche, on dirait.
Ça devrait les occuper un moment !

int.text: Keep moving! We've got you covered!
We've got other crawlers chasing us!

fra.text: Ils essaient de détruire la route !
On ne va pas y arriver !

int.text: I think it's SUPPOSED to be hard, Sideswipe. I mean, we are in a prison.
I told you! I don't know!
Spare me this mockery of justice!
Autobots! They've come to save us!
You're not going to free us?
We'll spread the word. Good luck!
You guys are a sight for sore optics!
You just give us the signal, Optimus!
We're ready to fight, just say the word!

fra.text: On veut se battre ! On attend tes ordres !

int.text:
This way! Hurry before the 
Decepticons come!
Look -- that's the one who fought Starscream! He doesn't look so tough.

fra.text: Regardez... C'est l'Autobot qui a affronté Starscream ! Il n'a pas l'air très fort.

int.text: You gonna talk now? I want the location!

fra.text: Tu vas parler, oui ? Je veux cette position !

int.text:
Data signature confirmed. Opening 
main gate.

Alert! Alert! Autobot Prisoners 
have escaped custody! Shoot to kill!

Alert! Alert! All prison cells,
deactivated.
Unauthorized access detected in cell block 14.  Reinforcements en route.
Hey!  Who are you calling little?
We captured them trying to raid supplies outside of Kaon.

Bring in the heavy turret. We'll 
blast it open!
Well THAT's a first. Nobody's ever escaped before!
Ha! I would never have guessed.
Yeah -- and those other two Soundwave hangs out with? They may be small, but they're REALLY mean. Enjoy their work a little too much if you ask me.
They won't get far. Soundwave hates loose ends.
He's kind of terrifying, if you ask me. Him AND Laserbeak. You see what they did to those Autobots yesterday? Scarred my optics, I'm telling you.
Well. Look at this. The PRODIGY returns.
I knew you couldn't resist rescuing Zeta Prime...which is why I orchestrated the entire thing. Zeta contacting you...your capture...all of it. All to bring YOU before ME.  Welcome to your defeat.

Don't flatter yourself, Optimus. What I do, I do for ALL of Cybertron! My orbital station's Energon Bridge is back online...allowing me to create an infinite supply of Dark Energon. I shall use that power to return our planet to its former glory!
You cannot defy destiny, Optimus!  I WILL bring order to Cybertron!
Why do you continue this pointless struggle? You know I'm right!

OUR war, Optimus--a war that I am winning.  I've tamed the great Omega Supreme.  Zeta and the other Primes have fallen.  And yet YOU continue to resist the inevitable.  You have the power to end this conflict right now with one simple choice.
Take your Autobots, and leave Cybertron forever.
Or stay, and face complete annihilation.
I was hoping you'd say that. It will make destroying you all the more satisfying!
Enough of this. You're about to join Air Raid and the thousands of other Autobot fools as our prisoners. Permanently.
Decepticons! Do NOT allow the Autobots to reach Zeta Prime!

fra.text: Decepticons ! Les Autobots ne doivent PAS atteindre Zeta Prime !

int.text:
You will never leave this prison 
alive, Optimus!
Have faith, Bumblebee--and follow my lead.

fra.text: Aie confiance, Bumblebee... Et reste derrière moi.
Patience. Encore un peu de patience.

int.text: The Energon Bridge.  It powers Megatron's orbital base.

fra.text: Le pont d'énergon. Il alimente la station orbitale de Megatron.

int.text: Thank you, Air Raid. The plan is working perfectly. By allowing ourselves to be captured, we've gained access to the prison -- and now stand a much better chance of saving Zeta Prime.
It's too great a risk right now, unarmed as we are...but I promise, we'll come back for Air Raid as soon as possible. ...Let's get moving.
Hmm. We'll have to smash through these grates.
These grates look brittle enough to break through.

fra.text: Ces grilles ont l'air assez fragiles pour être détruites.

int.text:
Ready your energy blades--we'll drop 
down and surprise them!
THAT's what this is about? REVENGE for what happened so long ago?
This is our home, Megatron.  We will stay.  We will fight.  And we will win!
Hold on, Zeta.  We'll get you out of there!
You're mad, Megatron! Your war is destroying the very planet you want to save!

Megatron teleported us directly into 
a prison cell.
Hmmm. Autobots -- I'm sensing faint energy emanations from that wall.

There is much you don't know about 
me, Sideswipe.

fra.text: Tu as encore beaucoup à apprendre sur moi, Sideswipe.

int.text: No, I'm afraid not. Doing that requires all of my reserve power, and takes a long time to recharge.

Air Raid surveyed this prison 
thoroughly-when we find him, we 
find our answer.

Your freedom is near, my brothers 
Be patient--be strong--and be ready 
to fight.
Air Raid -- where are the controls to your cell?

Hold tight, Air Raid. We'll get you 
out.

We're not finished until EVERY Autobot 
here is free.

fra.text: Nous devons encore libérer TOUS les autres Autobots enfermés ici.

int.text:
Let's give the Decepticons something else to think about. Its time to 
free our Autobot brothers. Who wants to do the honors?

Autobots! We must escort our brothers 
to safety!
Provide cover fire for the escapees!
Air Raid -- make sure the prisoners get out safely, then escort them back to Iacon. We'll meet you there.

We're not leaving without Zeta Prime. 
Now go!
Now. Let's get who we came for.

This wall crawler should carry us to 
the lower levels.
The crawler's main servos still function. Now that it's been disarmed, we can use it for transport.
Bumblebee... we're locked inside an enemy prison, surrounded by countless Decepticons bent on our destruction.

fra.text: Bumblebee... Nous sommes enfermés dans une prison et entourés de milliers de Decepticons impatients de nous détruire...

int.text: It's purely a matter of perspective.
My axe is fully recharged.  This way, Autobots!
The Decepticons will pay dearly for this.

fra.text: Les Decepticons paieront cher cette infamie.

int.text: That current looks strong.  Don't let it pull you into those grinders.
The clamps are up.  Now to deactivate that shield.
Focus your fire on the little one!
First we crack the shell...then we crack the nuts inside
Enjoy your stay, Autobots. Rust in peace.
Optimus is right -- we've been in tougher spots than this. Wow...Megatron has gathered quite the army, hasn't he?

Yeah? What exactly do you think 
they're recycling?
You certainly took your sweet time, Air Raid!
Air Raid said they were service ducts.
NOW we're talking! I hate sneaking around!
Keep your head down -- we've got snipers everywhere!
Who cares?  Its shooting at us!  Shoot back!
What do they have him hooked up to?
These little guys are SO ANNOYING.
That lousy bucket of bolts CHEATED, that's what.

No offense, Optimus, but I don't see 
how that's going to help.
Didn't know you could do THAT!

fra.text: Je savais pas que tu pouvais faire ÇA !

int.text: There's gotta be a way to open these doors!

fra.text: Il doit bien y avoir un moyen d'ouvrir ces portes !

int.text: We took the extended tour, saw the sights, blasted some bad guys--the usual.
Well, I can't just call you  Bee  all the time. That'd get boring!

fra.text: Quoi, je peux pas t'appeler tout le temps Bumblebee. C'est lassant à la fin !

int.text:
Can it, Air Raid, we're working,
here!
You sure you know where you're going Air Raid?
We can funnel them to the side hangars!
You ready for this, Bee? It's the big finale!
Shield your audio receptors!  Here it comes again!
We can't blast through that shield!
He's off the platform!  Now's our chance!
Well, I'm lovin' this. Let's crack some heads!
Looks like we got 'em all.  Of course--I got most of 'em.
Must be how they recycle their prisoners.

fra.text: C'est comme ça qu'ils recyclent leurs prisonniers...

int.text: There!  Its working.  Down we go!
You'd think the Decepticons would have an easier way to unlock their cells.
Damage--substantial!  Must re-energize with Zeta's life stream!
The Autobots are secured. Escape is impossible.
A noble sentiment, Optimus.  But I'm afraid, I am dead--already.
